title: Base Power hero
description: A full-bleed photo hero 90% of the window tall: a star rating, a big tight headline, one line of copy and a white zip-code bar with a lime button inside. Desktop sets it bottom-left over a scrim from the left; phones stack it at the top, centred, with a full-width button. The photo settles from a slight zoom over 7s and the content rises in on load.
notes: carries the dark class itself (light ink over the photo); the form stays light via the foreground colour
sized by the window: 90svh, at least 38rem
CSS-only animations, off with reduced motion
